$comment: Provenance of the recorded test fixtures (docs/TESTING.md §7.3-2: new fixtures are recorded, not hand-written).
A fixture proves its provenance in one of two ways, and `fixture-provenance.test.ts` enforces that every file does one of them:
1. an in-file `recordedWith` header — what scripts/conformance/record.ts writes, and what the hand-assembled envelope fixtures carry;
2. an entry in `recorded` below — for fixtures that are a verbatim wire body, where adding a key would make the fixture differ from the real response (§9 forbids hand-edited shapes).
`recordedWith` states how the bytes were obtained. `evidence` cites where that was recorded at capture time (a test header, a commit) — it is never inferred.

`legacyUnverified` lists fixtures that predate this manifest. HIK-10 established provenance for the fixtures new in 0.16.0 only; these were not investigated and their provenance is UNKNOWN, not assumed. It is a frozen grandfather list, not a parking place: a fixture added from now on fails the test unless it carries a header or a `recorded` entry.
